title: Memory
summary: What the assistant remembers across chats, readable and editable by the author.
description: Some things hold for every conversation: how the author wants to be helped, what they're working on, what to push them on. They're kept apart from chats so a new chat starts with them.

stories.as: an author who works with the assistant over months
stories.want: it to remember what I told it
stories.soThat: I don't explain myself again in every chat

requirements.text: The assistant keeps a memory apart from chats, of what the author asks it to remember or tells it about how they want to be helped.
Every turn carries the memory, and deleting a chat keeps it.
The memory is shown on a screen where the author can edit and delete each entry.
The assistant can add, change and remove memory entries, and nothing else it writes outside its chats.
